title.value: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.
title.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyflufluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products. - 2023 Session, New Hampshire-2024-HB465-Introduced

location.provenance: State of New Hampshire, In the Year of Our Lord Two Thousand Twenty Three

status.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products. - as it is introduced

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

date.provenance: This act shall take effect July 1, 2025.

who.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not ...

action.provenance: shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

products.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

exceptions.provenance: This paragraph shall not apply to the sale or resale of used products.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: No mention of 'currently unavoidable use' in the document.

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally added' means the addition of a chemical in a product that serves an intended function in the product component.
